name: 1.1.9 - Sydney or Tempe
notes: Each eBay order goes into COSTAR Sydney (Br1) or COSTAR Tempe (Br11), chosen with two buttons in the 404 extension 1.6.0 panel (wheel/package titles suggest Tempe; the other choice asks to confirm).
